description: Labeled dataset for measuring BIMGuard rule accuracy. Labels are by design.

not_measured.READINESS_POLICY: Config rule. Determines aggregate status rather than emitting a finding. Measured separately as a project-level readiness assertion.
not_measured.DUPLICATE_REVISION_CONTENT: Upload API may reject duplicate checksums before the rule runs. Not reliably constructible via HTTP.
not_measured.MISSING_METADATA: The create-document API auto-fills author from the current authenticated user, so an empty-author document cannot be constructed via HTTP.
not_measured.UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE: Requires bimguard.elements/1 fixtures with element-level BasedOn properties. Deferred to v2.
not_measured.SPATIAL_CONFLICT: Requires real IFC geometry with actual clearance computation. Deferred.
not_measured.OUTDATED_REFERENCE: Requires element-level BasedOn chains across revisions. Deferred.
not_measured.PARAMETER_MISMATCH: Requires coordinated psets across two documents via matching element tags. Deferred.
not_measured.CROSS_DOC_TAG_MISSING: Requires JSON fixtures with distinct element sets across two documents.
not_measured.CROSS_DOC_PROPERTY_DIVERGENCE: Requires JSON fixtures with property-level diffs across two documents.
not_measured.CROSS_DOC_TAG_UNEXPECTED: Requires JSON fixtures with distinct element sets.
not_measured.PART_COVERAGE: Manufacturing-domain only. Deferred to a separate manufacturing evaluation.

notes: UNREVIEWED_DOWNSTREAM fires only on documents reached INDIRECTLY (distance >= 2). Direct consumers are covered by STALE_DEPENDENCY, which is why S-300 is labeled for STALE_DEPENDENCY only, and G-700 (reached through S-300) is labeled for UNREVIEWED_DOWNSTREAM.
A-100 v2 has real element changes so change detection produces change records and impact analysis produces events for both S-300 (direct) and G-700 (indirect).
MISSING_METADATA was removed from measured_rules because the API auto-fills the author field before the rule runs.
